name: Semrush
oneLiner: SEO and AI-search visibility platform: keyword research, rank tracking, site audits and backlinks, with paid toolkits for local, content, social, ads and PR.
summary: Semrush is a subscription SEO platform for keyword research, competitor and backlink analysis, daily rank tracking and site audits. It is now sold as SEO + AI Search plans that also track brand mentions in ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini and Perplexity. Paid plans run from $139.95/mo (SEO, 500 tracked keywords) to $549/mo (Advanced, 5,000 keywords), each with one login; Local, Content, Social, Advertising, Traffic & Market and AI PR are separate toolkits, and Semrush's own timeline says it became an Adobe company in 2026.
notFor: Anyone who needs only occasional keyword lookups: the free plan caps at 10 reports a day and paid plans start at $139.95/mo
Teams that need many logins on a small budget: every extra user costs $45–$100/mo
Sites that need to track more than 500 keywords but cannot spend $299/mo (Pro+)
pros: Free account with 10 reports a day and 10 tracked keywords, no card required
7-day free trial on the SEO, Starter and Pro+ plans
Every paid plan includes daily rank tracking (500 to 5,000 keywords) and Site Audit
Starter and above track 50–200 AI-search prompts daily alongside classic SEO data
Month-to-month billing on every plan; annual billing saves about 16–17%
Local, Content, Social, Advertising and AI PR toolkits can be added or dropped one at a time
cons: Each plan includes one login; extra users cost $45, $80 or $100/mo depending on the plan
SEO and Starter both cap rank tracking at 500 keywords; 1,500 keywords needs Pro+ at $299/mo
Extra users get no AI Visibility access unless you pay another $99 per user
No refunds on month-to-month plans; the 7-day money-back guarantee covers only initial annual subscriptions and add-on purchases
